title: Concept: Card data collected in served markup
description: An input named for the card number or the security code in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: Collecting card data in the bank's own markup puts the page in scope for the card data rules, and any script on the page can read what the customer types.
applicability: Deployments that render an input named for the card number or the security code into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: Collecting card data in the bank's own markup puts the page in scope for the card data rules, and any script on the page can read what the customer types.
